name: hscript-seiun
description: Super-combined HaxeScript fork for SeiunEngine: hscript-iris base + hscript-improved classes/config + hscript-plus script-class inheritance (all MIT).
releasenote: Diagnostics and language surface: regex literals, object/array spread, structural switch patterns, enum abstract, class type parameters; script call-chain stack traces, typo suggestions and expected-token parser errors; faster operator dispatch, loop bodies without a per-iteration try/catch, single-lookup resolve.
